mechanism: Both drugs are renally eliminated and gabapentin may compete for renal tubular secretion; piperacillin tazobactam can reduce gabapentin clearance, increasing gabapentin levels.
action: Monitor for gabapentin toxicity (dizziness, ataxia, somnolence); consider gabapentin dose reduction in patients with renal impairment or during piperacillin tazobactam therapy.
